reported.quote: We reported our highest quarterly profit of INR 502 Crore in this quarter, having grown fivefold over the past 5 years.
Current financial year marks a clear turnaround, recording INR 995 Crore PAT in the first half as against INR 778 Crore PAT during the previous financial year.
Our H1 ROA stood at 5.9% and ROE stood at 23.8%.

guidance.quote: Basis our strong H1 FY27 financial performance. We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.
Basis our strong H1 FY27 financial performance. We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.
We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%, supported by return to growth in Group Loan portfolio, coupled with continued momentum in Retail Finance.

We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs and a higher capital position even after factoring the 50 -bps rate reduction applicable from October onwards.
Cost to income may range between 29% to 30% as operating costs remain well under control, despite inflationary trends.
We're maintaining our credit cost guidance of 3% to 4%, and it should comfortably cover for any volatility on account of evolving drought-related conditions in some operating geographies.
